title.fr: Les sports que pratiquent les Canadiens

text.en: Many young people in Canada play hockey — at school, in a league, or on a quiet street. Games in the street are called road hockey or street hockey. Parents drive their children to the rink.
text.fr: Beaucoup de jeunes au Canada jouent au hockey : à l'école, dans une ligue ou dans une rue tranquille. Les parties jouées dans la rue s'appellent le hockey de rue. Les parents conduisent leurs enfants à l'aréna.

source.quote: Many young Canadians play hockey at school, in a hockey league or on quiet streets—road hockey or street hockey—and are taken to the hockey rink by their parents.

verification.evidence: Many young Canadians play hockey at school, in a hockey league or on quiet streets—road hockey or street hockey—and are taken to the hockey rink by their parents.

text.en: Collecting hockey cards is an old habit in Canada. Children have done it for generations.
text.fr: Collectionner les cartes de hockey est une habitude ancienne au Canada. Les enfants le font depuis des générations.

source.quote: Canadian children have collected hockey cards for generations.

verification.evidence: Many young Canadians play hockey at school, in a hockey league or on quiet streets—road hockey or street hockey—and are taken to the hockey rink by their parents. Canadian children have collected hockey cards for generations.

text.en: One sport comes second for popularity in Canada: Canadian football.
text.fr: Un sport vient au deuxième rang pour la popularité au Canada : le football canadien.

source.quote: Canadian football is the second most popular sport

verification.evidence: Canadian football is the second most popular sport (see page 49).
